verdict: Paid ads went dark 8 days ago; the restart is the immediate priority.
narrative: Meta advertising has had zero spend and zero new leads since September 15th — all 55 leads and $510.52 in spend this period came from the first 20 days of the window. Your Google Business Profile remained active and generated 216 actions (67 calls, 106 direction requests, 43 website clicks) over the period, though profile activity also softened in the final week as brand visibility declined without paid support. We are reactivating the Meta campaigns this week, with the lead awareness campaign — which drove the majority of earlier spend — as the first to go back live. You should expect lead volume to resume once the campaigns are back in market, and we will confirm the restart with you directly.
